content: Opus Clip (opus.pro) is the cloud AI-clipping leader: ClipAnything AI clipping with natural-language prompts, virality score ranking each clip candidate by predicted engagement (hook strength, pacing, topic), dynamic word-by-word captions (claimed 97% accuracy), active speaker detection / AI relayout via ReframeAnything object tracking, AI B-roll insertion, brand templates (fonts/colors/logos), one-click multi-platform scheduling and publishing, team workspace and API; sources include YouTube, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, Twitch; 25-30+ languages; freemium model with 60 free processing minutes/month then paid credits; YouTube-link ingestion is a core supported input. Cross-checked against official site; virality score confirmed by secondary reviews (presenc.ai, opus.pro tools pages).
